info.name: A6 · Restaurant Menu API
info.description:
Self-test for set A6 (/api/dishes).

1. Start your server on port 8080 with NO data (restart it).
2. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner.
3. Restart the server before every full run.

Change the collection variable baseUrl if your server uses another port. These requests check the same rules as the question paper; the real evaluator uses different, random data.

exec: pm.test('every field echoed, text trimmed', () => { const s = {"dishName":"Paneer Tikka","restaurant":"Spice Garden","category":"Starter","price":220,"calories":320,"isVegetarian":true}; Object.keys(s).forEach(k => pm.expect(b[k], k).to.eql(s[k])); });

item.name: Id that does not look like an id → 404

exec: pm.test('JSON body with an error/message string', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(typeof (b.error !== undefined ? b.error : b.message)).to.eql('string'); });

pm.test('list shape: data, page, limit, total, totalPages', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data).to.be.an('array'); ['page','limit','total','totalPages'].forEach(k => pm.expect(b[k], k).to.be.a('number')); });
pm.test('totalPages = ceil(total / limit)', () => pm.expect(b.totalPages).to.eql(b.total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(b.total / b.limit)));
pm.test('creation order: first item is the first record', () => pm.expect(String(b.data[0].id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('id')));

pm.test('every item has id and all fields', () => b.data.forEach(r => ['id', ...["dishName","restaurant","category","price","calories","isVegetarian"]].forEach(k => pm.expect(r, k).to.have.property(k))));

pm.test('new values returned', () => { const s = {"dishName":"Updated Record Name","restaurant":"Updated Maker","category":"MainCourse","price":1666.67,"calories":5000,"isVegetarian":false}; Object.keys(s).forEach(k => pm.expect(b[k], k).to.eql(s[k])); });
